versions.content: If the ScheduleTable <ScheduleTableID> in a call of GetScheduleTableStatus is started AND NOT synchronous (deviation is not within the precision interval OR the ScheduleTable has been set asynchronous), GetScheduleTableStatus shall pass back SCHEDULETABLE_RUNNING via the ref- erence parameter ScheduleStatus AND shall return E_OK .

Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_00098 If the ScheduleTable <ScheduleTableID> in a call of GetScheduleTableSta- tus is started AND NOT synchronous (deviation is not within the precision interval OR the ScheduleTable has been set asynchronous), GetScheduleTableStatus shall pass back SCHEDULETABLE_RUNNING via the reference parameter Schedule Status AND shall return E_OK .
